Writing in the chat is measured from your first keystroke to Send. Pauses count up to a minute, and nothing counts while the app isn\'t on screen.

Reviewing is measured while a result is on the card, in the chat or over another app, until you send or put the text back. Waiting for the check doesn\'t count, and a card left alone counts up to two minutes.
Writing in other apps can\'t be seen, so it\'s estimated: its words times your own speed in the chat, in that language when there\'s enough, or a typical 4 s a word until there is.
Only messages you sent or put back count, and only while History is on. Thinking before you type and reading replies aren\'t counted. Deleting a message from History deletes its time.
Send a message in the chat, or put a checked message back in another app, and the time shows here.
History is off, so new messages aren\'t timed.
